resources.string: Don\'t know the flight number? Pick the airports and the day, and we\'ll list that day\'s departures.
Local date at the departure airport. Route search covers the next %1$d days.
Two characters, like 6E for IndiGo or AI for Air India.
A route search counts as two flight searches towards your daily limit.
Choose the airport you\'re flying from.
An airline code has two characters, like 6E.
No departures matched. Check the date (local time at the departure airport), or leave out the destination or the airline to see more flights.
City, airport or code, like Delhi or BOM
No airport matches. Try the city name or the three-letter code.
Search flights from the last 12 months. They go straight into your Passport, without alerts.
Add %1$s from %2$s to %3$s to your Passport
Check the date: it is the day the flight took off, in local time at the departure airport. Then check the airline code, for example 6E for IndiGo and AI for Air India.
Filled in from your calendar. Check the details before you track.
Your calendar says %1$s, but route search only reaches %2$s. Come back closer to the day, or search by flight number.
